text:
Subject: A gentle reminder regarding punctuality

Hi there,

I hope you are having a lovely day. I wanted to take a moment to chat about our upcoming client meetings. It is really important that we show up on time, as it reflects well on our team’s professionalism and respect for our clients.

I have noticed that there have been a few instances of tardiness recently. While I know life can be busy, this pattern needs to change to ensure we maintain our high standards. Please keep in mind that future instances of lateness may lead to disciplinary action, so I ask that you take the necessary steps to arrive on time.

On a lighter note, while you are commuting, take a moment to look up at the sky. Those fluffy things in the sky rain comes from are a beautiful reminder of how nature works, and perhaps spotting one might help you keep track of time or just bring a smile to your face before you head into the office.

Thank you for your attention to this matter and for your continued hard work.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
